title: SXT-020 patch image body (container segment after the header)
description: Patch content + compiler views of a patch image. Two top-level sections: 'graph' carries the verbatim normalized graph (every source field exactly once; rebuilding g from it must hash to header.normalized_graph_sha256) and 'derived' carries recomputable compiler views (SXT-015 model annotations, allocations, event timing, caveats). Canonical JSON bytes; header.body_sha256 covers this segment.

scalars.description: Verbatim scalar fields of g (whichever the graph stores): sm (scene mode id), smn, sa (active scene), spl (split point), poly (polylimit), ch/chn (character), fxb/fxbn (FX section bypass), fxd (per-slot disable bitmask), vol.

scenes.description: g.sc verbatim: both scenes incl. scene B (state carried even when routing-inactive). Each scene: playmode (pm/pmn), pitch/octave/bend ranges/keytrack/porta, filter block config (fbc/fbcn, f2off/f2lnk, fb, bal, lc, pfg, vca, vs, pan, wid), send levels [2] (buses 3/4 are an SXT-011 exposure gap: not exported, loader defaults apply), mixer mix{} (per path [level, mute, solo, route]), FM routing fm{}, osc[] (3 slots: t/tn, p[0..6] where p[0] is the family SUBMODE, pit, oct, kt, rt, uni, udet, wt flag), fu[] (2 filter units: t/tn, st/stn, cut, res, em, kt), ws{} (waveshaper t/tn/dr), lfo[] (6 records; MSEG/Formula carry the gap marker verbatim).

fx_slots.description: g.fx verbatim: every slot with i, r (routing role: ains1..4, bins1..4, send1..4, global1..4), t/tn, on, p[0..12] (Airwindows p[0] IS the algorithm id, exported also as aw/awn), rl (return level). Off slots carry only the bare identity fields, exactly as the graph stores them.

modulation.description: g.md verbatim: {g: global rows, s: [per-scene {s: scene-bus rows, v: voice-bus rows}]}; each row [source_id, source_scene, source_index, dest_synthside_id, dest_name, depth, normalized_depth]. Ids are stable within the recorded engine pin only; dest_name travels with every row so consumers never need an id map.

wavetable_assets.description: g.wta verbatim when present: per record sc, osc, name (raw-side display name; provenance), emb (embedded byte size), script, res ([[path under resources/data/wavetables, sha256], ...] for resolved tables).

dependencies.description: g.dep verbatim ('audio_input' when any osc slot's normalized type is Audio Input).

raw_note.description: g.raw_note verbatim (raw-sidecar waiver for Snare Tight.fxp).

voice_graph.description: SXT-015 derived voice view: scene mode, active scenes, voices_per_note (dual mode consumes two pool voices per note), polylimit, worst_case_voices = min(polylimit, bundle pool), per-scene osc slot activity/unison annotations (engine clamps unison to MAX_UNISON=16; raw out-of-range values annotated as unison_out_of_range, never rewritten), unison_load_per_voice, filter-unit and waveshaper activity, mseg_or_formula_lfos gap lists, LFO/envelope instance counts, voice_state_bytes_on_chip.

fx_section.description: Per-slot derived view: phase (0 scene_A_insert, 1 scene_B_insert, 2 send_bus, 3 global_insert), order_in_phase, engine_order = phase*10 + order (engine-fixed processing rank: A1->A4, B1->B4, scene sum, S1..S4 sends with per-slot return level, G1->G4 globals), enabled_by_fxd (fxd bit), routing_active, processes_this_frame, state_tier, class_state_unverified, airwindows_algorithm_selected. Section level: bypass id/name, disable mask, enabled/processing/distinct-type counts. Per-instance discipline: two slots of one class are two instances with separate state, always; fxd-disabled slots hold state but neither process nor gate.

allocations.description: Deterministic allocation from the SXT-015 model under the bundle voice-pool override. ALL numbers are placeholders [PENDING-SXT-016].

basis.description: accounting_model_version, params_digest, cost_profile, note (aggregate voice-state block until SXT-016/023 pin per-voice layout).

budgets.description: Bundle candidate budgets: on_chip_ram_bytes (4 MiB), external_writable_bytes (64 MiB), external_bandwidth_bytes_per_s (800 MB/s), cycle_closure (not_gated_pending_sxt_016). Candidates, not claims.

on_chip.description: blocks (voice_state aggregate first, then per-instance fx blocks in slot order; each {name, kind, offset, size_bytes}), total_bytes.

external_writable.description: per-instance external blocks in slot order (long delay/reverb buffers; classification: writable class > 64 KiB), total_bytes. Flash is NEVER a substitute for writable delay memory.

flash_assets.description: one block per wavetable record with embedded bytes; assets only.

fx_instances.description: per configured instance: slot, class, enabled/routing_active/processes_this_frame, region+offset+size, ext_reads/writes_per_frame, verification flags. Routing-inactive instances are allocated state and contribute no traffic.

bandwidth.description: ext_traffic_bytes_per_frame and per_s at 48 kHz (processing instances only).

cycles_placeholder_v0.description: cost columns + closure status. NOT GATED: placeholder-v0 columns only [PENDING-SXT-016].

event_timing.description: Required event queue depth, worst-case events per frame, peak events/s, source (SXT-012 fixture profile).

caveats.description: SXT-015 accounting anomalies verbatim (unison_out_of_range, slfo_defs_not_exported, class_state_unverified flags, asset observations). Recorded observations; they never alter patch content.

losslessness.description: normalized_graph_sha256 + the reconstruction rule verify.py applies (g = scalars + grouped sections; sha256(canonical_json(g)) must equal header.normalized_graph_sha256).

rules: Canonical JSON: sorted keys, separators ',' ':', ensure_ascii, allow_nan=false.
No timestamps, wall-clock, random, or machine-dependent values.
Fixed orders: engine arrays in engine order, FX slots by index, allocation blocks voice-first then slot order, rejection codes predictor-order then compiler-gate order.
Floats carried as SXT-011 exported them (6-decimal rounding at source) or SXT-015 model _r6 rounding.
Same graph bytes + same bundle file + same compiler version => byte-identical image bytes.
